explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 62 named tracks, releases, compilations and catalogue cuts across Bandcamp Daily's September 9 electronic survey, the linked official KAY BE, DJ Phil, Tee Illa and South Beach Recycling pages, Non Series' current retrospective and catalogue, plus adjacent recommendations. Written metadata and attributed descriptions only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Run 187's 999RECORDS999, Dedicated Floor and Koinen field was excluded in full; Runs 170–186 were not recycled. Canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects, untriggered PARKED revisits, prior unresolved titles and exact utility-ledger identities were excluded.

The scan covered current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue material. Nine exact-title leads survived without padding; three top-ranked tracks carry candidate-specific descriptions strong enough to avoid release-level belonging as a proxy for structure.
Other inspected items were excluded for weak track-level evidence, continuous-side identity, persistent-state duplication, future-only availability, or lack of a credible lawful boundary test.
Every placement pair was re-derived from the current 50-track ledger and checked for adjacency and prose agreement. The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer sequence remains untouched.
No Spotify connector, raw audio, audio-feature inference or invented identity was used.
